QuestInfo.name: The Returned Herbs
QuestInfo.0: You gave the potions to #p1063018#. Go to #b#m101030500##k to see if you can get the herbs back.
QuestInfo.1: #p1063018# apologized repeatedly and returned the herb. Now take the herb to #b#p1061005##k. You can find him in #bSleepywood#k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1061005# has now got his possessions back and is no longer suspicious of #m103000000#.

0.0: Here is the Herb I stole. I've already used a little of it, but no one will be able to tell. Please return #bthe Herb to its owner#k. I'm sorry for the inconvenience I've caused. Please apologize to the owner for me.

yes.0: I'll never do anything like this ever again. You're a lifesaver. Thank you so much for your help!

no.0: Hm? Don't you need the Herb back? If not, can I keep it?

1.0: It's been a long time, Evan. Have you heard anything about my Herb? I don't want to rush you, but there isn't anything else for me to do but blame #m103000000# for my stolen Herb. What? You found it?

yes.0: Oh, that's it! That's definitely my Herb! Wait, let me take a look!

npc.0: You haven't returned the Herb to its #bowner#k? I stole it from the man with a long face in #m105040300#. Could you also tell him that I am very sorry?

item.0: You haven't found the culprit that has stolen my Herb? See, it's gotta be one of those thieves in #m103000000#. What? You found the real culprit? Then go on and find my Herb for me. Hurry.

lost.0: Umm, hello there, lifesaver. Has anyone ever told you that you're a bit clumsy? You left the Herb here. I've been trying so hard not to use it until you came to get it. Please return it to its owner.
